summary: More community.general deprecations: profitbricks_volume_attachments, pure module utils and purestorage doc fragments, RedfishUtils._init_session, rocketchat is_pre740 default changing to false, and sensu_* modules in favor of sensu.sensu_go.
questions: What will the rocketchat is_pre740 default become?
Is the pure module utils being removed from community.general?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `profitbricks_volume_attachments`: removed in 11.0.0.
- `pure` module utils and `purestorage` doc fragments: removed in 12.0.0.
- `RedfishUtils._init_session()` deprecated.
- `rocketchat`: `is_pre740` default changes from `true` to **`false`** in 13.0.0.
- `sensu_check`, `sensu_client`, `sensu_handler`, `sensu_silence`: removed in 13.0.0; use the **`sensu.sensu_go`** collection.
